ImageDescription.value:
Before removing the late blight infected plants we sprayed with a very strong Oxidate (hydrogen peroxide) solution to try to kill the fungus spores. Hopefully that will keep things from spreading while we're working in the plants.

Since we were going to be removing the plants this was an opportunity to test the phytotoxicity of Oxidate in high concentrations. This was a dilution of 25 to 1 instead of the normal 100 to 1. This was the worst example of spray injury I found. Most of the plants were not affected much.
